title: Can We Stop The Ads? Taxonomy and Characterization of Smartphone Splash Ads and Existing Countermeasures
abstract: arXiv:2609.17316v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Splash ads are full-screen advertisements that pop up and appear as the first interaction page when users start an app, often tricking users into unknowingly activating certain trigger mechanisms, such as moving the phone to redirect users to other profit-driven third parties. So far, splash ads have already caused significant real-world impacts, ranging from significantly delaying emergency response to distracting drivers, as well as degrading accessibility of apps to vision-impaired users. We analyze 108 documented implementations of advertising defenses to examine their applicability to splash ads and the requirements users face when deploying them.   Our analysis identifies substantial deployment barriers, including device rooting or jailbreaking, runtime code injection, and application modification. translated_title: 我们能阻止这些广告吗？智能手机开屏广告及现有对策的分类与特征分析
translated_abstract: 开屏广告是一种全屏广告，当用户启动应用时会弹出并作为首个交互页面出现，常常诱骗用户在不知情的情况下激活某些触发机制，例如通过晃动手机将用户重定向到其他以盈利为目的的第三方。迄今为止，开屏广告已经造成了重大的现实影响，包括显著延误紧急响应、分散驾驶员注意力，以及降低视障用户使用应用的无障碍性。我们分析了108个已记录的广告防御实现，以检验其对开屏广告的适用性以及用户在部署它们时面临的要求。我们的分析识别出了重大的部署障碍，包括设备root或越狱、运行时代码注入和应用修改。而不需要这些要求的方案仍然可能涉及额外权限、规则维护、源代码编译或付费。
tldr: 本研究对智能手机开屏广告及现有防御措施进行了系统分类与特征分析，通过对108个广告防御实现的分析发现，现有对策普遍面临设备root/越狱、代码注入、应用修改等重大部署障碍，难以被普通用户便捷使用。
en_tdlr: This study provides a taxonomy and characterization of smartphone splash ads and existing countermeasures, analyzing 108 documented ad-blocking defenses and identifying substantial deployment barriers—such as device rooting/jailbreaking, runtime code injection, and app modification—that hinder ordinary users from effectively blocking splash ads.
